subject: From Grok: Hon Dolo chain winners + angles
body: Ziggy picked Hon Dolo's four staple chains: HD-CHAIN-A01 (14mm gold Cuban, iced box clasp), A04 (gold wheat chain, engraved twin-ship disc), A06 (fully iced gold Cuban) and B05 (gold curb chain, gold dice). The winner angles are in From Grok\HD-CHAIN_winners_v001: 16 product-only images, 4 per chain (round-1 hero plus clasp/pendant/link macro, bust view and flat lay), with REVIEW-SHEET, MANIFEST.json and NOTES.md under the CFA jewelry display standard. A01 ang3 (stray clasp) and ang4 (reads bracelet-length) are regen candidates. The 2 optional chain-bite proofs have not been made. #47 is not a default, and James J-N01 to N04 stay separate.
